name: Amaya Ayuno
source: Ren's best and childhood friend who is a member of the martial arts club. Because of her tomboyish looks and personality, she is popular with the girls. A bit of narciccist, but she has her well-mannered side as well. Ayuno is also the younger sister of [url=/c35463]Miu[/url], whom she does not get along with.
